gcp.reviewed.network.no_default_vpc.description: For a GCP VPC network, this evaluator flags FAIL when name is exactly default. Automatically created network paths and firewall defaults can expose workloads unexpectedly.
gcp.reviewed.network.no_default_vpc.pass_when: PASS when name is not default.
gcp.reviewed.network.no_default_vpc.fail_when: FAIL when name is exactly default.

gcp.reviewed.project.os_login_2fa.not_applicable_when: Compute Engine API is disabled in the project; no VM uses project metadata.

gcp.reviewed.sql.cmek.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the primary Cloud SQL instance has no diskEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyName. The dataset or storage layer uses provider-managed keys, removing the intended customer key control over decryption.

gcp.reviewed.sql.cmek.fail_when: FAIL when the primary Cloud SQL instance has no diskEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyName.
gcp.reviewed.sql.cmek.not_applicable_when: Not a primary Cloud SQL instance.

gcp.reviewed.sql.high_availability.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when a primary Cloud SQL instance has availabilityType=ZONAL. A single-zone failure may interrupt the database until recovery completes.

gcp.reviewed.sql.high_availability.fail_when: FAIL when a primary Cloud SQL instance has availabilityType=ZONAL.
gcp.reviewed.sql.high_availability.not_applicable_when: Read replica or external SQL instance is outside primary-instance predicate.

gcp.reviewed.sql.mysql_local_infile.fail_when: FAIL when the local_infile database flag is on instead of the accepted off setting.

gcp.reviewed.sql.mysql_skip_show_databas.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the skip_show_database database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting. Users may enumerate database names they were not meant to discover.

gcp.reviewed.sql.mysql_skip_show_databas.fail_when: FAIL when the skip_show_database database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting.

gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_connection.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the log_connections database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting. Relevant database activity may be absent from audit or diagnostic logs.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_connection.pass_when: PASS when the log_connections database flag is on.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_connection.fail_when: FAIL when the log_connections database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting.

gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_disconnect.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the log_disconnections database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting. Relevant database activity may be absent from audit or diagnostic logs.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_disconnect.pass_when: PASS when the log_disconnections database flag is on.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_disconnect.fail_when: FAIL when the log_disconnections database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting.

gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_error_verb.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when a PostgreSQL instance declares log_error_verbosity=terse, including reviewed source default handling. Relevant database activity may be absent from audit or diagnostic logs.

gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_error_verb.fail_when: FAIL when a PostgreSQL instance declares log_error_verbosity=terse, including reviewed source default handling.

gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_statement.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the log_statement database flag is none instead of the accepted ddl setting. Relevant database activity may be absent from audit or diagnostic logs.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_statement.pass_when: PASS when the log_statement database flag is ddl.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_log_statement.fail_when: FAIL when the log_statement database flag is none instead of the accepted ddl setting.

gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_pgaudit.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the cloudsql.enable_pgaudit database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting. Relevant database activity may be absent from audit or diagnostic logs.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_pgaudit.pass_when: PASS when the cloudsql.enable_pgaudit database flag is on.
gcp.reviewed.sql.postgres_pgaudit.fail_when: FAIL when the cloudsql.enable_pgaudit database flag is off instead of the accepted on setting.

gcp.reviewed.storage.access_logging.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when logging.logBucket is empty or absent. Requests to the bucket may lack access logs for incident review.

gcp.reviewed.storage.access_logging.fail_when: FAIL when logging.logBucket is empty or absent.

gcp.reviewed.storage.lifecycle.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when the bucket lifecycle has no valid action-and-condition rule. Objects may accumulate without the intended expiry or transition rule, extending the data retention window.
gcp.reviewed.storage.lifecycle.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the bucket lifecycle has no valid action-and-condition rule.
gcp.reviewed.storage.lifecycle.fail_when: FAIL when the bucket lifecycle has no valid action-and-condition rule.

gcp.reviewed.storage.soft_delete.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when softDeletePolicy.retentionDurationSeconds is zero. Deletion or corruption may be harder to reverse because an adequate recoverable copy is unavailable.
gcp.reviewed.storage.soft_delete.pass_when: PASS when the retention duration is a positive integer.

gcp.reviewed.storage.versioning.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when collected versioning.enabled is false instead of true. Deletion or corruption may be harder to reverse because an adequate recoverable copy is unavailable.
gcp.reviewed.storage.versioning.fail_when: FAIL when collected versioning.enabled is false instead of true.

gcp.sql.backups.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when collected settings.backupConfiguration.enabled is false instead of true. Point-in-time recovery may be unavailable after data loss or an unauthorized change.
gcp.sql.backups.fail_when: FAIL when collected settings.backupConfiguration.enabled is false instead of true.

gcp.sql.no_public_ip.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when collected settings.ipConfiguration.ipv4Enabled is true instead of false. The declared network path may expose the workload or management service to unsolicited internet traffic.
gcp.sql.no_public_ip.fail_when: FAIL when collected settings.ipConfiguration.ipv4Enabled is true instead of false.

gcp.sql.restrict_authorized_networks.description: For a GCP Cloud SQL instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the evaluator finds broad authorized networks in the collected declarations. The database may expose sensitive records or lose diagnostic evidence about misuse.
gcp.sql.restrict_authorized_networks.pass_when: PASS when no broad authorized networks are found.
gcp.sql.restrict_authorized_networks.fail_when: FAIL when the evaluator finds broad authorized networks in the collected declarations.

gcp.storage.no_public_iam.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when a bucket IAM policy has an unconditional allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers grant and publicAccessPrevention is not enforced. Bucket objects may be readable or modifiable by an untrusted principal. A declared public grant with enforced public access prevention returns MANUAL.

gcp.storage.no_public_iam.fail_when: FAIL when a bucket IAM policy has an unconditional allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers grant and publicAccessPrevention is not enforced.

gcp.storage.public_access_prevention.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when publicAccessPrevention is inherited and the effective organization policy does not enforce storage.publicAccessPrevention. A public IAM or ACL declaration may become effective on the bucket.
gcp.storage.public_access_prevention.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: publicAccessPrevention is inherited and the effective organization policy does not enforce storage.publicAccessPrevention.
gcp.storage.public_access_prevention.fail_when: FAIL when publicAccessPrevention is inherited and the effective organization policy does not enforce storage.publicAccessPrevention.

gcp.storage.uniform_access.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when iamConfiguration.uniformBucketLevelAccess.enabled is false. Object ACLs can grant access outside the reviewed bucket IAM policy.
gcp.storage.uniform_access.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: iamConfiguration.uniformBucketLevelAccess.enabled is false.

gcp.subnetwork.private_google_access.fail_when: FAIL when collected privateIpGoogleAccess is false instead of true.
